description: Move to ESLint 9: bump the eslint devDependency and create a minimal flat config (eslint.config.mjs) when none exists.
name: eslint-9-flat-config
notes: Creates a MINIMAL flat config (js recommended rules only) — your legacy .eslintrc rule set is not translated (rule translation is semantic). Existing .eslintrc files are listed as unhandled for manual migration. If eslint.config.mjs already exists the create step fails the plan (ifExists: fail) rather than overwriting it.
